## FAQ
- **What is GEO?** Generative Engine Optimization is the practice of engineering websites to rank in AI search responses from ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Copilot.
- **How long does GEO take?** Initial AI citations within 4-8 weeks, full authority in 3-6 months.
- **How is GEO different from SEO?** SEO optimizes for Google rankings. GEO optimizes for AI model citation. GEO focuses on entity clarity, structured data depth, and citation-worthiness.
